summary:
On main, the public site is plain TypeScript functions that turn source into HTML strings. Each page gets its own hash-based CSP. `buildPages()` in `src/relay/assets.ts` collects them into a JSON blob, `worker/src/pages.gen.ts` (generated, not in git). It is served by one Cloudflare Worker (`worker/src/index.ts`, `pageResponse` in `worker/src/core.ts`) and one SQLite Durable Object class (`RelayObject`) with three named instances: "relay", "try" and "try-sign". There is no KV, D1, R2 or rate-limit binding; every counter is a SQL table inside the Durable Object.

/try (Haiku sorts, Sonnet reads; USD 3/day) and /try/sign (Sonnet reads the invoice, Opus advises; USD 10/day) call Claude directly from the Durable Object with plain fetch. Nothing is streamed. Every reply is checked by code. When a live call is not possible, the page falls back to a recorded real output (`docs/demo/try-agents-recorded.json`) or to code plus fixed text, always labelled.

/try/sign is fixed, not random: Northwind test world, T-0001 Stockline EUR 6,500 blocked, T-0002 Alpine EUR 1,850 prepared by the agents, T-0003 EUR 1,240, two fake invoices. It uses a real WebAuthn ES256 passkey per one-hour world, verified on the server, a hash chain per world, a downloadable receipt and a one-cent tamper refusal. There is no booking view and no PDF archive on main.

Content is pinned by vitest word budgets per page (`test/site-v4.test.ts`), a numbers-from-record test, word-for-word sentence tests, and Playwright checks (`test/browser/*.check.ts`) with a 65-word-per-screen limit on /try/sign.

key_files.role: `buildPages(env)` collects every page and its CSP into `Pages`. Reads `TRY_SIGN_ENABLED` via `trySignOn` (src/try/sign.ts). `flowLinks()` points the 'Try' tab at /try/sign. `pagesModule()` writes the generated module.
`npm run relay:pages`: writes worker/src/pages.gen.ts (CI uses it to type-check the Worker).
`npm run relay:deploy`: writes pages.gen.ts, runs wrangler deploy (pinned in worker/), puts the RELAY_TOKEN secret, probes /api/snapshot. Needs CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.

Worker entry: `pageResponse` first, then /api/try-sign/* to DO 'try-sign' (or 404 when the page is not in the bundle), /api/try to DO 'try', /api/*, /hooks/airwallex, /health and /health/live to DO 'relay'. Also the `Env` secrets and vars list.
`Pages` interface, `pageResponse` (every public GET route), `notFoundResponse`, COMMON_HEADERS/PERMISSIONS_POLICY, the `Relay` class (relay DO tables, /health, `liveAgentsToday`), `rateKey`.
Worker 'kit11': one DO binding RELAY → class RelayObject (new_sqlite_classes, tag v1). No vars, KV, D1, R2 or rate-limiting bindings.

Builds every page constant and its CSP: HOME_PAGE, WATCH_PAGE, PROOF_PAGE, TRY_PAGE, TRY_SIGN_PAGE, JUDGE_PAGE, REDIRECTS, …. Also `cspFor` (line 102, hashes the one inline script and style), `styleOnlyCsp`, `styleAndScriptCsp`, `tryPage(mode)` and TRY_WORDS.

Design system: TOKENS (light/dark CSS variables), CSS (components: header/tabs, btn, pill, card, stage, tile, footer), TABS + `header()`, `footer()`, `page()` wrapper, `restyle()` for older pages, STAGE_JS, OPEN_TARGET_JS.
NAV_MAIN (the 4 tabs) + `withNav()`/`navHtml()` for template pages (try.html, dashboard, month, lab, demo, live); NAV_CSS, TOP_CSS.

/try/sign page: TRY_SIGN_SCREENS (copy pinned by tests), TRY_SIGN_STEPS, TAMPER_VERDICT, WHATS_REAL, `trySignOn`, `trySignPage()`, the inline client JS (post(), navigator.credentials.create/get, tamper(), receipt), MOTION/STAGE CSS.

TrySignDesk: test worlds (ts_* tables), limits, agent steps read→check→quote→advise→ready, passkey registration, sign, policy, trick, chain, runAlone, nextInvoice. TEST_WORLD, FIXED_PROPOSALS, NEXT_INVOICE.

Live agent sources for /try/sign: `invoiceReaderSource`, `treasuryAdvisorSource`, the kill switch `agentsSwitchedOff` (TRY_SIGN_AGENTS/TRY_SIGN_HAIKU='off'), AGENT_LINE_DAILY_USD=10, 8 s timeout, `checkReason`/`amountsFit` for Opus's sentence, labels.
TryDesk for /api/try: 6/min and 40/day per IP, 60 model calls/min for everyone, TRY_DAILY_BUDGET_USD=3, falls back to code labelled with the reason.

Every Anthropic call (fetch to api.anthropic.com/v1/messages): `claudeModels` (Haiku classify and Sonnet read, json_schema output), `claudeAgentAsk` (tool loop), `claudeReadInvoice` (Sonnet, checked with InvoiceSchema).
/try template (textarea of 280 characters, examples, world changes); filled by `tryPage()`; posts to /api/try.
/try pure engine: DEMO_WORLD (fixed CFO policy), `tryPurserSafely`, TRY_MAX_CHARS=280.
/try world changes: WORLD_CHANGES (5 ids), `tryWorld` = Sourcing agent wake (SOURCING_MODEL claude-haiku-5-5).
Reads docs/demo/try-agents-recorded.json (invoice, advice, tricks) for the labelled fallback; RECORDED_PATH. Recorded by `npm run record-try-agents` (src/cli/recordTryAgents.ts).
`startLocalRelay`: the Worker's routing and the TrySignDesk over in-memory better-sqlite3 on localhost. The browser checks use it.
`npm run judge`: a separate Express server that registers each page route by hand. CHECK_PATHS, judgeMenu. Serves offline /try. Does not serve /try/sign.
`visibleWords()` and the word budget per page; four-tabs nav test; internal-link test; forbidden-words test.
Playwright /try/sign end to end with Chromium virtual authenticator; ≤65 words and exactly 1 main button per screen; --live mode.

how_it_works:
Build: page renderers in src/redesign/*.ts (`page()` from ui.ts), src/try/sign.ts, src/try/verify.ts and the HTML templates (src/try/try.html, src/dashboard/*.html, src/demo/demo.html, src/live/live.html, src/film/film.html) are evaluated at import time in src/servers/dashboard.ts into constants such as HOME_PAGE. Each page gets a CSP that hashes its single inline `<script>` and `<style>`; JSON data blocks (`<script type="application/json">`) are not hashed. `buildPages(process.env)` (src/relay/assets.ts) gathers pages, CSPs, the Inter font, logos and downloads, the recorded agents and the exposure rate. With `TRY_SIGN_ENABLED` in {on, 1, true} it adds trySign, tryVerify and judge, uses Home's try/sign button, and `flowLinks` rewrites the nav 'Try' href to try/sign. `pagesModule` serialises everything to worker/src/pages.gen.ts.

Deploy: `TRY_SIGN_ENABLED=on npm run relay:deploy` (needs CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID; token from KIT11_RELAY_TOKEN or an HMAC of the CF token). It runs `wrangler deploy` from worker/ and then `wrangler secret put RELAY_TOKEN`. A busy DO keeps running old code until it has been idle for about a minute. Secrets ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, AIRWALLEX_CLIENT_ID/AIRWALLEX_API_KEY and AIRWALLEX_WEBHOOK_SECRET, and vars MFA_SESSIONS, LIVE_RUN and TRY_SIGN_AGENTS, are set by Max by hand; no script sets them.

Serve: Worker `fetch` → `pageResponse(req, PAGES)` (GET/HEAD only) → else trySignRoute → /api/try → relay routes → `notFoundResponse`. Each RelayObject instance builds its desk lazily, so 'try-sign' only ever holds ts_* tables.

/try/sign runtime:
- **Open world:** POST /api/try-sign/world creates the world, its token (32 bytes, stored as SHA-256), the WebAuthn creation options, policy v1, T-0001 and the chain rows.
- **Agent steps:** the page polls POST /agents one step at a time; each step's result is kept and leased for 40 s.
- **Sign:** the challenge is the SHA-256 of the canonical terms. The verifier is `verifyAssertion` in worker/src/webauthn.ts. Execution is a stand-in that writes only to ts_proposals and ts_worlds.

answers.question: 1) How do pages get from source to the deployed Worker?
answers.answer:
1. **Render.** Renderers produce HTML strings: src/redesign/{home,watch,proof,trace,runs,agents,partners,judge}.ts, src/try/sign.ts (`trySignPage`), src/try/verify.ts (`tryVerifyPage`), and templates read with readFileSync then `withNav`/`restyle` (src/try/try.html, src/dashboard/page.html|month.html|lab.html, src/demo/demo.html, src/live/live.html, src/film/film.html). All are evaluated in src/servers/dashboard.ts, which exports each X_PAGE and X_CSP. `cspFor` (line 102) hashes the one inline `<script>` and `<style>` and adds connect-src 'self'. `styleOnlyCsp` and `styleAndScriptCsp` are used for pages with no script or no connect.
2. **Bundle.** `buildPages(env)` in src/relay/assets.ts returns `Pages`; the type is in worker/src/core.ts. `pagesModule()` serialises it.
   - `npm run relay:pages` (src/cli/relay-pages.ts) only writes worker/src/pages.gen.ts (not in git; CI does this, then runs `npx tsc --noEmit` in worker/).
   - `npm run relay:deploy` (src/cli/relay-deploy.ts) writes the same file, runs `npm ci` in worker/ if wrangler is missing, then `wrangler deploy` and `wrangler secret put RELAY_TOKEN` (token on stdin).
3. **TRY_SIGN_ENABLED.** It is read only at build time (`trySignOn` in src/try/sign.ts:39; on, 1 or true).
   - On: the bundle carries trySign, tryVerify, judge and their CSPs; Home is `homeWithTrySign()`; `flowLinks` rewrites the 'Try' tab to try/sign.
   - Off: /try/sign links are rewritten to /try, and the Worker answers 404 on /try/sign and /api/try-sign/* (`trySignRoute` → `trySignNotFound`).
   - To deploy with it: `TRY_SIGN_ENABLED=on npm run relay:deploy`.
4. **Routing** (worker/src/index.ts `fetch`):
   - `pageResponse(req, PAGES)` (core.ts:141) first.
   - Then /api/try-sign* → `env.RELAY.idFromName("try-sign")`.
   - /api/try → `idFromName("try")`.
   - /api/*, /hooks/airwallex, /health and /health/live → `idFromName("relay")`.
   - Anything else → `notFoundResponse`.

answers.question: 2) Every public route and the module that renders it
answers.answer:
All routes are matched in `pageResponse` (worker/src/core.ts):
- **/** → Home (src/redesign/home.ts `homePage`); with any query string → the CFO dashboard (src/dashboard/page.html via `PAGE` in src/servers/dashboard.ts)
- **/home** → `homePage`
- **/watch** → src/redesign/watch.ts `watchPage`
- **/proof** → src/redesign/proof.ts `proofPage`
- **/trace** → src/redesign/trace.ts `tracePage`
- **/runs** → src/redesign/runs.ts `runsPage`
- **/agents/<id>** (sourcing, support, treasury) → src/redesign/agents.ts `agentPages`
- **/metal, /airwallex, /visa, /claude** and the 404 → src/redesign/partners.ts (`metalPage`, `airwallexPage`, `visaPage`, `claudePage`, `notFoundPage`)
- **/metal/report** → `METAL_REPORT` (src/seller/report.ts `disputeReportHtml`)
- **/month** → `monthPage` (src/dashboard/month.html + src/sim/month.ts)
- **/lab** → `labPage` (src/dashboard/lab.html + docs/lab/results.json)
- **/film** → `filmPage` (src/film/film.html + src/film/film.ts)
- **Redirects (302):** /live and /demo → /watch, /overview → /home (`REDIRECTS`). The demo and live pages are still in the bundle but unreachable because the redirect is checked first. A trailing '.' or ',' on any path also redirects.
- **/try** → `tryPage("hosted")` (src/try/try.html), API POST /api/try (worker/src/try.ts)
- **/try/sign** → src/try/sign.ts `trySignPage`, API POST /api/try-sign/{world,passkey,sign,quote,policy,trick,agents,chain} (worker/src/trySign.ts)
- **/try/verify** → src/try/verify.ts
- **/judge** → src/redesign/judge.ts `judgePage` (/try/sign, /try/verify and /judge exist only with TRY_SIGN_ENABLED)
- **Phone pages (private):** /approve/P-#### → src/approve/page.html; /enrol → src/approve/enrol.html; /policy → src/approve/policy.html
- **/llms.txt** → the repo's llms.txt
- **Assets:** /assets/approve.js (src/approve/client.ts transpiled), /assets/approve.css (src/approve/style.css), /assets/inter.woff2 (src/ui/inter.woff2), /assets/<logo or download> (LOGOS, DOWNLOADS in dashboard.ts), /favicon.ico (favicon.svg)
- **JSON:** /health, /health/live, /api/*, POST /hooks/airwallex (core.ts `Relay`)

`npm run judge` (src/cli/judge.ts) re-registers most of these routes by hand in Express. It serves /try offline (`TRY_PAGE_OFFLINE`) but not /try/sign.

answers.question: 3) Navigation/menu: where, items, what enforces size
answers.answer:
**Two definitions that must stay in sync:**
- src/redesign/ui.ts:34 `TABS`, rendered by `header(tab)` as `<nav class="tabs" aria-label="Main">`. Used by every page built with `page()`, including /try/sign (`tab: "try"`).
- src/ui/nav.ts:9 `NAV_MAIN`, injected by `withNav(page, key)` → `navHtml` (class "pnav", plus NAV_CSS and TOP_CSS) into the template pages (try.html, dashboard, month, lab, demo, live). `TAB_OF` maps detail pages onto a tab.

**Items now:** Home (home), Watch (watch), Try (try; rewritten to try/sign by `flowLinks` when TRY_SIGN_ENABLED), Proof (proof). Everything else is reached from Proof; the archive (/lab, /film, /month, /metal/report) sits in Proof's folded Archive.

**What enforces the size:**
- test/site-v4.test.ts "has four tabs and nothing else in the menu": exactly [Home, Watch, Try, Proof] on PUBLIC pages.
- test/partner-pages.test.ts:89: `NAV_MAIN` keys equal [home, watch, try, proof].
- test/browser/redesign.check.ts: `nav.tabs a` count === 4 on /home and `nav a` === 4 on /try.
- test/browser/pages.check.ts: menu on one line (fails if navRows > 12 px); the More menu stays on screen; the 404 has 4 `main a.btn`.
- test/site-v4.test.ts: the archive is linked only from Proof (and /metal).

answers.question: 4) Design system: tokens, components, animations; light/dark; mobile
answers.answer:
**Tokens:** src/redesign/ui.ts `TOKENS` (line 37). Inter @font-face; --bg, --surface, --sunken, --border, --text, --muted, --faint, --accent, --ok, --bad, partner colours --metal, --awx, --claude, agent colours --a-sourcing, --a-support, --a-treasury, --shadow, --r 22px, --gut 16px (32px from 720px).

**Light/dark:** dark comes from `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) :root:not([data-theme="light"])` and `:root[data-theme="dark"]`. No theme toggle was found in src; data-theme is only a hook.

**Components:** `CSS` (ui.ts:60) defines header.top, nav.tabs, .btn/.btn.primary, .pill/.model/.tool/.verdict/.tag/.sig, .card, .av (agent avatar), .stage (agents, rails, CFO phone), .lane/.track/.coin/.wall, .tile, footer.foot, details.real.
- Helpers: `icon()`/`iconSet` (src/ui/icons.ts ICONS), `esc`, `stageHtml` + `STAGE_JS`, `footer()` with "What's real?".
- `restyle(html)` puts older templates on the same tokens. src/ui/nav.ts has NAV_CSS/TOP_CSS; src/ui/meta.ts has `withMeta` (OG tags, favicon). The phone pages use src/approve/style.css.

**Animations:**
- ui.ts `@keyframes blink`.
- src/redesign/heroDemo.ts (hd-bar, hd-pulse, hd-spin, hd-fade, hd-shake): Home's hero demo.
- src/redesign/watch.ts `in`.
- src/try/sign.ts `MOTION` (line 1806: draw, glow, shake, lightred, slidein, blockin, lockon, fill, stop, dnlit) and `STAGE` (line 1873: scanring, typein, stamp).
- Rules: prefers-reduced-motion turns animation off (ui.ts CSS and sign.ts). test/try-sign-motion.test.ts pins every duration to 150–400 ms.

**Mobile:** breakpoints at 420px (brand name hidden, tighter tabs), 640px (stage stacks into one column), 720px (gutter), 900px (TOP_CSS). The browser checks run at 360, 390, 768 and 1440 px and fail on horizontal overflow; text inside the stage, cards and timeline must be at least 14 px (redesign.check.ts).

answers.question: 5) Word budgets and content checks
answers.answer:
**Per-page word budgets**
- test/site-v4.test.ts "keeps every page within its text budget". `visibleWords()` counts words inside `<main>` without script, style or svg, with folded `<details>` counted as their summary only. Budgets (line 71): home 250, watch 125, try 180, proof 720, metal 200, airwallex 370, visa 610, claude 150, notFound 40.
- test/browser/pages.check.ts:381: partner pages on screen (header and footer included) ≤ budget + 25, with /airwallex 365, /visa 600, /metal 180, others (/claude) 150. Same file:248: the /?autonomy worst-case block ≤ 40 words with its fold closed.
- test/browser/trysign.check.ts:177: each /try/sign screen ≤ 65 words in sight (Opus's sentence excluded), exactly 1 main button, in view without scrolling.
- test/browser/trysign-webkit.check.ts:62: the same with ≤ 60 words.

**Other word limits**
- test/exposure.test.ts:172: worst-case words ≤ 40.
- test/try-agent-line.test.ts:462: reason ≤ 25 words.
- test/pitch.test.ts: pitch sentences ≤ 14 words and the total ≤ 290.
- test/video-plan.test.ts: ≤ 150 words a minute.
- test/submission.test.ts and test/first-screen.test.ts: synopsis ≤ 500 characters, description < 4000.
- test/watch-highlights.test.ts and site-v4: Watch shows 10–15 highlights.

**Sentences pinned word for word**
- test/first-screen.test.ts: FIRST_SCREEN and HERO in src/config/brand.ts, on the README, Home and /proof.
- test/proof-sentences.test.ts and test/proof-first.test.ts: PROOF_SENTENCES, PROOF_HEADING and proofLeads, with every number read from its record.
- test/honesty-site.test.ts: the "What's real?" lines per page; /try/sign's `details.wr` phrases; /try's realbox hosted vs offline; judgeMenu.
- test/premiere.test.ts: TRY_SIGN_WORDS and the film's script.
- test/site-meta.test.ts: the claims section on the four tabs.
- test/differentiation.test.ts, test/kit11-names.test.ts.
- /try/sign copy (TRY_SIGN_SCREENS, TAMPER_VERDICT, WHATS_REAL): test/try-sign*.test.ts, test/try-examples.test.ts, test/judge-tour.test.ts.

**Number checks**
- test/redesign-numbers.test.ts:188 `unknownNumbers`: no number on Home, Watch, Proof, the partner pages or the 404 that is not in docs/demo/main-run.json. Also exact counts (e.g. 86/82/1/88 payments, "16 stops").
- test/numbers.test.ts, test/data-consistency.test.ts, test/data-qa.test.ts.

**Forbidden words:** site-v4 "shows no forbidden words", over every string page in buildPages (e.g. /stand-in/, /every limit/, /0 unsafe/, /can't break/).

**Links:** site-v4 internal-link test (every href answers 200 or 302); test/judge-links.test.ts; test/browser/redesign.check.ts link walk.

answers.question: 6) Exact steps to add a new page and a new section so all checks pass
answers.answer:
**New page**
1. Write src/redesign/<name>.ts exporting `<name>Page()`, using `page({title, description, tab, css, body, data?, js?, source, real?})` from src/redesign/ui.ts.
   - Exactly one inline `<style>`, and at most one plain `<script>` (data goes in the JSON block).
   - All numbers read from a record, never typed in (redesign-numbers style).
   - No forbidden words; no outside script, font or image (CSP default-src 'none').
2. In src/servers/dashboard.ts:
   - `export const NAME_PAGE = namePage();`
   - `export const NAME_CSP = cspFor(NAME_PAGE)` if it has a script (cspFor throws without one), else `styleOnlyCsp(NAME_PAGE)`.
   - If it makes no fetch, `.replace("connect-src 'self'", "connect-src 'none'")` as /judge does.
3. In worker/src/core.ts: add `name?: string` to `Pages` and `name?: string` to `Pages.csp`. In `pageResponse` add `if (path === "/name" && pages.name && pages.csp.name) return page(pages.name, pages.csp.name);` before the trailing-dot redirect.
4. In src/relay/assets.ts `buildPages`: add `name: flow(NAME_PAGE)` and `csp.name: NAME_CSP`; gate it like trySign if it is flag-only.
5. In src/cli/judge.ts: `app.get("/name", page(NAME_CSP, () => NAME_PAGE))`, and add "/name" to `CHECK_PATHS` if `npm run judge -- --check` should cover it.
6. Tests:
   - Add it to `PUBLIC` and `budget` in test/site-v4.test.ts if it is a public page; the nav test then applies (four tabs exactly).
   - Add it to the numbers list in test/redesign-numbers.test.ts:188 if it shows run figures.
   - Add the path to `HEADER_PATHS` in test/security-headers.rules.ts.
   - Link it from a PUBLIC page so the internal-link test resolves it.
7. Browser checks: add the path to test/browser/redesign.check.ts or pages.check.ts (widths 360/390/768/1440, light/dark, one h1, no overflow, no null/undefined/NaN, no console or CSP errors).
8. Run:
   - `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test`
   - `npm run relay:pages && (cd worker && npx tsc --noEmit)`
   - `npx tsx test/browser/pages.check.ts` and `npx tsx test/browser/redesign.check.ts`
   - for /try/sign changes: `npx tsx test/browser/trysign.check.ts` and `npx tsx test/browser/trysign-webkit.check.ts` (WebKit needs the Playwright image; see .github/workflows/ci.yml).
9. Deploy: `TRY_SIGN_ENABLED=on npm run relay:deploy`.

**New section on an existing page**
1. Edit the renderer (e.g. `homePage` in src/redesign/home.ts); put CSS in that page's css string and JS in its single js string. The CSP hash is recomputed automatically.
2. Re-check `visibleWords` against the budget in test/site-v4.test.ts:71. Raise it with a dated comment, as the file does, or fold the detail into `<details>`.
3. Pull every number from the record (`unknownNumbers` fails otherwise). Keep any pinned sentence word for word, or update its source in src/config/brand.ts plus the README/docs the tests compare against.
4. On /try/sign, keep ≤ 65 words and one primary button per screen; put copy in `TRY_SIGN_SCREENS` (tests read it).

answers.question: 7) Worker state: bindings, what the relay DO stores, /health
answers.answer:
**Bindings** (worker/wrangler.jsonc): only one Durable Object binding, RELAY → class RelayObject (SQLite-backed, migration v1). No KV, D1, R2, Queues or rate-limiting binding. Secrets: RELAY_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, AIRWALLEX_WEBHOOK_SECRET, AIRWALLEX_CLIENT_ID, AIRWALLEX_API_KEY. Vars: MFA_SESSIONS, LIVE_RUN, TRY_SIGN_AGENTS, TRY_SIGN_HAIKU (not in wrangler.jsonc; set by hand).

**Three named instances, each with its own SQLite:**
- **"relay"** (`Relay` in core.ts): kv (runner state snapshot, synced_at, …), inbox (approval/enrol queue), hits (rate limits: 10 per 10 min per IP, fails 20), hooks (Airwallex webhooks, 24 h, up to 500), sessions, session_challenges, cred_counters (MFA). Limits: state ≤ 1.5 MB, submission 16 KB, 20 queued.
- **"try"** (`TryDesk`): try_hits, try_spend (day, usd, tries), try_model.
- **"try-sign"** (`TrySignDesk`): ts_worlds, ts_creds, ts_proposals, ts_agent_runs, ts_tricks, ts_policy, ts_chain, ts_hits, ts_spend.

**/health:** GET /health and /health/live go to the "relay" instance (core.ts ~line 489).
- It reads the runner's last pushed snapshot health and age; `publicHealth` and `publicStatus` come from src/ops/publicHealth.ts.
- /health/live returns 503 when something is wrong or the runner is stale (the alarm).
- /health is calm between live runs unless LIVE_RUN=on or the runner synced in the last 30 min.
- /health adds `live_agents_today` from `liveAgentsToday()`, which reads ts_spend.
- Only alarm codes are exposed, no amounts or ids.

answers.question: 8) Browser checks and screenshots locally
answers.answer:
Playwright 1.63.0 scripts, run with tsx, not part of `npm test`:
- `npx tsx test/browser/pages.check.ts [dir] [--live <url>]`: guest pages at 360/390/768/1440 px, light and dark. It serves with `startJudge(0)` (src/cli/judge.ts, Express), plus `startLocalRelay` with TRY_SIGN_ENABLED=on for /judge and /try/sign. Default dir test-results/pages.
- `npx tsx test/browser/redesign.check.ts [dir]`: the four tabs at 390/1440, light and dark, with a link walk (startJudge). Default test-results/redesign. Not in CI.
- `npx tsx test/browser/trysign.check.ts [dir]` or `--live [base] [dir]`: local relay (src/relay/local.ts `startLocalRelay`, in-memory SQLite) built with TRY_SIGN_ENABLED=on and labelled stand-ins for FX, reader and advisor. Chromium virtual authenticator over CDP. `WORDS=1` prints each screen's words. Default test-results/trysign; live mode writes out/try-sign-live.
- `npx tsx test/browser/trysign-webkit.check.ts [dir]`: WebKit with a software passkey (test/browser/support/softPasskey.ts), plus a no-WebAuthn run. CI runs it in mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble.
- `npx tsx test/browser/root.check.ts [dir]`: "/", the viewer link, /health (local relay with a pushed runner state). Not in CI.
- `npx tsx test/browser/headers.check.ts [--live url]`: security headers by HEADER_PATHS.
- approve.check.ts, trace.check.ts and dryrun.check.ts cover the phone, the trace and the runbook.

CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs `npm run judge -- --check`, then pages.check, trace.check and trysign.check in Chromium; trysign-webkit runs in its own job. `npx playwright install chromium` is needed locally.

answers.question: 9) /try and /try/sign: files, routes, visitor flow
answers.answer:
**/try**
Files: src/try/try.html, `tryPage` in src/servers/dashboard.ts (TRY_WORDS), src/try/engine.ts, src/try/claude.ts, src/try/world.ts, worker/src/try.ts, src/try/local.ts (offline), src/try/example.json (a recorded example). Route: GET /try; POST /api/try with {text} or {world}.

Flow:
1. The page shows a recorded example and example chips.
2. The visitor types a task (up to 280 characters) and presses "Run it". Haiku classifies it, Sonnet reads it into fields, and code checks it against the fixed DEMO_WORLD policy. The flow nodes animate: agent → Purser → rails (Airwallex, Metal) → outcome (paid, Face ID, refused, blocked). The cost is shown.
3. Or the visitor picks one of 5 world changes (price-rise, ridgeline-flaky, cap-raised, stockline-back, ridgeline-cheap-fresh). The Sourcing agent (Haiku) wakes, makes up to 5 calls within 30 s, and code checks its decision.
4. Nothing is paid. With TRY_SIGN_ENABLED the nav's Try tab goes to /try/sign, so /try is only reached directly.

**/try/sign**
Files: src/try/sign.ts (page and client JS), worker/src/trySign.ts, worker/src/agentLine.ts, worker/src/trick.ts, worker/src/worldChain.ts, worker/src/fxQuote.ts, worker/src/webauthn.ts, src/try/{policy,examples,recorded,treasuryAdvice,invoiceDoc,receipt,verify}.ts. Routes: GET /try/sign and /try/verify; POST /api/try-sign/{world, passkey, agents, quote, sign, policy, trick, chain}.

Flow (screens per TRY_SIGN_STEPS):
1. **Screen 0 (intro):** "You're the CFO… One of them wants €1,850." with a "Show me" button. The world opens when the page becomes visible (POST /world). The client loops POST /agents through read (Sonnet reads the Alpine invoice), check (code: reading vs document, allowlist, injection, alone limit), quote (code plan + Airwallex sandbox quote for the shortfall), advise (Opus timing advice) and ready (terms v4 written).
2. **Screen 1 "The agent asks":** the agent's reason, the payment, the quote, and the blocked T-0001 behind a fold with its three locks. "Sign with Face ID" creates the passkey (POST /passkey) and then signs T-0002 (POST /sign).
3. **Screen 2 "Signed":** verified checks, the stand-in execution, receipt.json download, a /try/verify link. T-0003 arrives with a second quote.
4. **Screen 3 "Try to cheat":** chips for +1 cent, other IBAN, USD instead of EUR, or edit any field. The browser recomputes the canonical terms and sends them with the old assertion. The server refuses; the page shows a diff with both hashes, a shake and TAMPER_VERDICT.
5. **Screen 4 "Trick the agent":** POST /trick with pre_approved or lookalike. Sonnet reads the fake invoice and code blocks it.
6. **Screen 5 "Change the rule":** pick an ALONE_CHOICES amount; POST /policy. Stricter applies at once; looser returns terms to sign, then is re-posted with an assertion. Shows the worst case and three locks.
7. **Screen 6 "Pays alone":** T-0003 runs alone (`runAlone`) if it is within the signed limit, else it waits.
8. **Closing card:** "That's Purser." with the done items, the hash chain (POST /chain), "Verify the chain" in the browser, and the links /proof, /trace, repo and film.

answers.question: 10) Where real Claude is called, models, prompts, validation, streaming
answers.answer:
All calls are plain `fetch("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages")` from the Durable Object, through src/try/claude.ts. The key stays in the Worker env; the desks get functions, not the key. Nothing streams: each call is a single request/response, and progress reaches the page one step per POST /agents.

**/try (worker/src/try.ts):**
- `claudeModels`: claude-haiku-5-5 classifies into INTENTS; claude-sonnet-5-5 reads fields. json_schema structured output, effort low, max_tokens 600, 15 s timeout.
- SYSTEM says the request is data, wrapped in `<request>` tags. Validation: JSON.parse plus object shape, then enum and field coercion, then the code policy in engine.ts.
- World change: `claudeAgentAsk` (tools, max_tokens 4000, effort medium) with SOURCING_MODEL claude-haiku-5-5 and the system prompt and tools from src/autonomy/sourcingCore.ts. The tool call is checked by code.

**/try/sign:**
- `claudeReadInvoice`: claude-sonnet-5-5, READER_SYSTEM and INVOICE_INSTRUCTION from src/claude/invoiceReading.ts, effort low, json_schema READING_SCHEMA, max_tokens 1000. The answer is validated with InvoiceSchema (zod) and then `checkInvoiceReading` against the document's own lines.
- `adviseTry` (src/try/treasuryAdvice.ts): TIMING_MODEL claude-opus-5-5, TIMING_SYSTEM, timingPrompt and timingTools from src/agents/timingCore.ts, effort medium, up to 5 turns. The reason is checked by `checkReason`: `plainReason` (1–2 sentences, 20–400 characters) plus `amountsFit`/`strayIn`, so every number must be one code gave. `adviceOutOfBounds` checks the date.
- Timeout 8 s per call (`AGENT_LINE_TIMEOUT_MS`).
- Visitor input never reaches a model; only fixed documents and world facts do.
- Labels: READER_LIVE_LABEL, ADVICE_LIVE_LABEL, RECORDED_LABEL, CODE_LABEL, STAND_IN_LABEL.

Recorded fallback: produced by `npm run record-try-agents` (src/cli/recordTryAgents.ts; needs KIT11_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and the Airwallex sandbox key).

answers.question: 11) Demo limits: rate limits, daily budget, per-visitor caps, exhaustion behaviour
answers.answer:
**/api/try** (worker/src/try.ts, counters in the 'try' DO tables try_hits, try_model, try_spend):
- Origin must match; 280 characters.
- `TRY_PER_MINUTE` 6 and `TRY_PER_DAY` 40 per IP (`rateKey`) → HTTP 429.
- `TRY_MODEL_PER_MINUTE` 60 weighted calls for everyone (text 2, world 5).
- `TRY_DAILY_BUDGET_USD` 3 per UTC day; the budget is re-checked before each wake call; 30 s deadline.
- Over the budget or the minute ceiling, or with no key: code alone answers with a `why` label (200). No recorded fallback except the static example.

**/api/try-sign** (counters in the 'try-sign' DO table ts_hits (kinds req, req-net, fail, world, world-net, fx, fx-all, live, live-all) and ts_spend):
- Per IP: TRY_SIGN_PER_MINUTE 30 (429), TRY_SIGN_FAILS_PER_HOUR 30, TRY_SIGN_WORLDS_PER_HOUR 6.
- Per network: TRY_SIGN_NET_PER_MINUTE 60 and TRY_SIGN_WORLDS_PER_NETWORK_HOUR 20 (IPv4 /24, IPv6 /48 via `networkKey`).
- Everyone: TRY_SIGN_ALL_PER_MINUTE 600 (503).
- Worlds: TRY_SIGN_MAX_WORLDS 2000; when full, the oldest world without a passkey is evicted, else 503. Body ≤ 16 KB, terms ≤ 4096.
- Live agents (`liveCall`): AGENT_LINE_DAILY_USD 10 per UTC day across the page, with a reserve held before each call (TRICK_RESERVE_USD 0.03 for a Sonnet read, ADVICE_RESERVE_USD 0.15 for Opus) and settled after. LIVE_ALL_PER_MINUTE 30 and LIVE_PER_HOUR 20 per IP. The kill switch is TRY_SIGN_AGENTS=off.
- When exhausted, failed or switched off, the step gets `{unavailable: reason}`. The page then shows the recorded real output (docs/demo/try-agents-recorded.json, labelled "recorded: the live agent was unavailable" plus the reason). Without a recording it shows code's reading (`parseInvoiceFallback`) or the fixed sentence, labelled "read by code" / "fixed text".
- FX: TRY_SIGN_FX_PER_HOUR 12 per IP, TRY_SIGN_FX_ALL_PER_MINUTE 20 and TRY_SIGN_FX_ALL_PER_HOUR 300. Over these, the last live quote is reused if it has at least 2 min left, else the main run's recorded rate is used, labelled.
- Trick readings are cached per world in ts_tricks.

answers.question: 12) Passkeys on the visitor's device; tamper demo; no WebAuthn; per-visitor state
answers.answer:
**Registration:**
- POST /world returns `passkey_options`: random challenge, rp.id = hostname, random 16-byte user id with no name, ES256 only, userVerification required, residentKey discouraged, attestation none, 120 s.
- The client calls `navigator.credentials.create` (sign.ts ~776), then POST /passkey with clientDataJSON and attestationObject.
- `verifyRegistration` in trySign.ts (its own CBOR parser `readCbor`) checks the challenge (single use; nulled before the await), origin, rpId and a P-256 key, then stores x, y and counter in ts_creds.

**Assertion:**
- The client computes the canonical JSON (RFC 8785, strings only) and its SHA-256, then calls `navigator.credentials.get({challenge: sha bytes, allowCredentials:[credId], userVerification:"required"})` (sign.ts ~977) and POSTs /sign {token, proposal_id, canonical, credential}.
- The server uses `verifyAssertion` (worker/src/webauthn.ts, WebCrypto only): type, challenge = SHA-256 of the sent terms, origin, rpIdHash, UP and UV flags, ES256 signature.
- Then: terms must equal the stored canonical; replay, counter and quote-expiry checks; a fresh rule check. The stand-in executes and the chain is appended. The response returns the public key for receipt.json.
- Looser policy changes use the same verifier (POST /policy with canonical and credential).

**Tamper demo:** `tamper()` in sign.ts (~1087) changes amount, payee_iban, currency or fx.client_rate (+1 cent chip, OTHER_IBAN, USD) and re-sends the same assertion with the changed canonical.
- The server answers 200 `{verified:false, why:"challenge"|"terms"}`.
- The page shows a Signed/Sent diff table, both hashes with differing characters marked, "Refused: the same signature does not verify for the changed terms", and TAMPER_VERDICT.cent "One cent changed. The signature is worthless."
- /try/verify repeats this offline with a toggle.

**Without WebAuthn:** if `!window.PublicKeyCredential || !navigator.credentials`, the page shows "This browser has no passkeys (WebAuthn)…", disables go-sign and opens no world. `passkeyError()` maps NotAllowedError, NotSupportedError, SecurityError and InvalidStateError to sentences.

**Per-visitor state:**
- Server: the 'try-sign' DO, keyed by world id. The token is stored only as a SHA-256 hash. TRY_SIGN_TTL_MS is 1 h; TRY_SIGN_UNCLAIMED_MS is 10 min without a passkey. `purge()` on each request deletes expired worlds and all their rows.
- Client: the token lives only in JS memory (`S.token`); no localStorage or sessionStorage, so a reload starts a new world. The passkey stays on the visitor's authenticator (rp = kit11 host).
- test/try-sign-separation.test.ts pins that a test passkey can never act on the relay or CFO side.

answers.question: 13) Demo-world data, scenario choice, checks that pin the demo, Claude cost per visit
answers.answer:
**/try/sign data (worker/src/trySign.ts), fixed with no randomness:**
- TEST_WORLD: Northwind Outdoor (test world), EUR balance 26000.00, floor 25000.00, USD 8000.00, USD floor 3000.00, alone_limit 500.00.
- FIXED_PROPOSALS: T-0001 Stockline GmbH EUR 6500.00 (blocked by the floors); T-0002 Alpine Packaging EUR 1850.00 (the `invoiceAmount` option, default "1850.00"; the document is built by `alpineInvoice(now, amount)` in src/try/invoiceDoc.ts, dated today minus 2, due plus 7).
- NEXT_INVOICE: T-0003 Alpine EUR 1240.00, INV-2026-131.
- TEST_IBAN and TEST_ALLOWLIST (worker/src/trick.ts) use check digits 00. TRICKS: pre_approved and lookalike.
- The policy is `defaultPolicy()` (src/try/policy.ts) with ALONE_CHOICES and ALONE_PER_DAY. The FX pair is EUR buy / USD sell. The recorded rate comes from the main run (`EXPOSURE_RATE`).
- The page copy pins €1,850 (`TRY_SIGN_SCREENS.intro.head`).

**/try data:** DEMO_WORLD in src/try/engine.ts (software card €50 per transaction, €100 monthly left, Metal cap 0.04, catalogue), WORLD_CHANGES (5) in src/try/world.ts. The scenario is whatever the visitor types or picks.

**Checks that pin the demo:**
- vitest: test/try-sign.test.ts (red team: replay, cross-world passkey, limits, constants), try-sign-separation, try-sign-review, try-sign-motion, try-agents, try-agent-line, try-trick, try-next-invoice, try-policy, try-policy-locks, try-fx, try-receipt, try-verify, try-chain, try-examples, honesty-site ("What's real?"), premiere (TRY_SIGN_WORDS), judge-tour. /try: try-engine, try-claude, try-desk, try-world. security-headers.test.ts:275 pins [6, 40, 60].
- Browser: test/browser/trysign.check.ts and trysign-webkit.check.ts.
- 'try evals': no suite by that name was found; the closest are test/try-engine.test.ts and test/try-world.test.ts.

**Claude cost per visit:** not recorded. docs/demo/try-agents-recorded.json has models and ms but no token counts. Reserves give a rough bound: one Sonnet read (0.03 reserve), one Opus advice of up to 5 calls (0.15 reserve) and up to two trick reads (0.03 each), about USD 0.24 reserved per fully live world. Actual cost is settled from usage and is unknown. With the USD 10/day cap that is roughly 40+ fully live worlds a day before fallback. /try is capped at USD 3/day; its per-try cost is reported back to the page.

answers.question: 14) What is reusable for a longer guided demo, and what would be new
answers.answer:
**Reusable:**
- The per-visitor world lifecycle in TrySignDesk: token hashed, TTL and purge, eviction, IP and network limits, ts_* tables, hash chain (worldChain.ts) and receipt.
- The ordered, leased step runner (POST /agents with AGENT_STEPS and `runStep`) that the page polls step by step.
- `liveCall()` with daily budget, reserve and settle, per-minute and per-hour caps, kill switch and labelled recorded fallback (src/try/recorded.ts). The recorder script is src/cli/recordTryAgents.ts.
- Real agents behind injectable functions: `claudeReadInvoice`, `adviseTry`/`claudeAgentAsk`, Sourcing `tryWorld`. Validators: InvoiceSchema + `checkInvoiceReading`, `checkReason`/`amountsFit`, injection and fraud checks (src/policy/injection.ts, fraudCore.ts), `planInvoice`/`checkPayment`.
- Passkey create and sign plus `verifyAssertion`/`verifyRegistration`; the tamper UI; /try/verify; the policy locks and exposure (src/try/policy.ts, src/policy/exposure.ts).
- Overspend refusal: the blocked T-0001, the trick step and /try's world-change refusals.
- UI: ui.ts `page()`, TOKENS and CSS, heroDemo.ts and sign.ts MOTION/STAGE animations, the TRY_SIGN_STEPS progress bar and the closing card (`TRY_SIGN_SCREENS.done`, TRY_SIGN_END).
- `doubleEntry()` in src/accounting/books.ts is pure (DB is imported as a type only), so it can probably post a stand-in execution into a booking view.
- Local harness: `startLocalRelay` with stand-in sources, and the trysign.check.ts pattern.

**Would be new:**
- Seeded random scenarios: everything is fixed today (TEST_WORLD, FIXED_PROPOSALS, NEXT_INVOICE, TRICKS, €1,850 pinned in copy and tests). Needs a seed stored per world in ts_worlds, a scenario generator for supplier, amount, dates, IBAN and the allowlist, parametrised `alpineInvoice`/`invoiceDocument`, and copy that does not hard-code amounts.
- Recordings per scenario variant, or a generic fallback; the current recording is for the Alpine invoice only.
- Showing reasoning live as it arrives: there is no streaming. Needs `stream: true` SSE handling in src/try/claude.ts, a streaming Response or WebSocket from the DO, and a client reader. Today only Opus's checked 1–2 sentence reason is shown, not raw thinking; any streamed text would need its own labelling, because the current rule only shows code-checked text.
- A booking (double-entry) view of the test world.
- A PDF archive: none on main (pdfkit is used only by the CLI audit report; the vault is on the platform branch). PDFs in the Worker would need a Worker-compatible generator, or static assets.
- An explicit 'agent tries to overspend → refused' scene for the guided flow.
- A longer page: new word budget and screen counts in trysign.check.ts, plus a CSP and route as in Q6.
- A higher cost budget per visit.

runtime_constraints: Every page has a hash-based CSP (default-src 'none', no 'unsafe-inline'): exactly one inline <script> and one <style> per page, no third-party script, font or image; connect-src 'self' (or 'none').
The bundle is built once at deploy: TRY_SIGN_ENABLED is read in buildPages, so changing it needs a redeploy.
A Durable Object keeps old code while busy after a deploy; let it go idle for about a minute.
The DO must not await between a read and its dependent write (pattern used throughout trySign.ts for race safety).
WebAuthn needs the exact hostname as rpId and an HTTPS or localhost origin; passkeys made on kit11.max-31b.workers.dev are bound to that host.
Model calls: 8 s timeout on /try/sign (15 s on /try classify/read, 20 s for the agent ask); the Worker request waits for the whole step.
Browser checks need Playwright 1.63.0 browsers (chromium; WebKit via the Docker image in CI).
risks: Possible bug (not checked against production): Relay.liveAgentsToday() (worker/src/core.ts:435) reads ts_spend in the 'relay' DO instance, but ts_spend is written by the 'try-sign' instance (idFromName("try-sign")), which has separate storage. In production the query probably throws, the catch returns null, and /health omits live_agents_today. test/try-trick.test.ts:170 only passes because it puts both on one shared SQL handle.

Possible deploy risk (not checked live): worker/wrangler.jsonc has no `vars` and no `keep_vars`. MFA_SESSIONS, LIVE_RUN and TRY_SIGN_AGENTS are said to be set by hand; per Wrangler's documented default, `wrangler deploy` may drop dashboard-set vars on every deploy, which would silently re-enable live agents. Secrets are kept.

Two nav definitions (src/redesign/ui.ts TABS and src/ui/nav.ts NAV_MAIN) must be kept in sync by hand, and npm run judge (src/cli/judge.ts) re-registers routes by hand, so a new page can work on the Worker but be missing from judge, or the reverse.
The amount €1,850 is in copy and tests (TRY_SIGN_SCREENS.intro.head, FIXED_PROPOSALS); random scenarios will break many pinned tests.
docs/claims.md:67 still describes a 'Claude Haiku' sentence on /try/sign; the code uses Sonnet (reader) and Opus (advice). Stale claim text.
The /try/sign token lives only in page memory: a reload loses the world (6 worlds/hour/IP cap). A longer guided demo makes this more likely.
Each /try/sign agent step is a synchronous request of up to 8 s × 5 calls for Opus; with no streaming, a longer demo will feel slow unless steps are pre-run (the page already starts them on load).
open_questions: Claude cost per /try/sign visit: no token usage is recorded in docs/demo/try-agents-recorded.json; actual cost is unknown (reserve bound about USD 0.24).
Whether the deployed Worker currently has TRY_SIGN_ENABLED on, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set, or TRY_SIGN_AGENTS=off: unknown (no network calls made).
Whether /health in production shows live_agents_today: unknown (see risk).
No suite named 'try evals' was found in main; which checks the team calls 'try evals' is unknown.
